title: Phase 1 Operator Demo Script Checklist
description: Machine-testable checklist for an operator-led Phase 1 local mock demo. It defines the recommended speaking order, static preview pages, allowlisted validation commands, expected signals, and blocked actions.

demoFlow.title: Read project rules and Phase 1 boundary
demoFlow.expectedSignal: Phase 1 allows docs, schemas, examples, CLI Mock, AI Task Mock, review flow, and tests only.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Start by stating that this demo is MOCK_ONLY and follows DSL to CLI to Mock to Workflow to Operation.

demoFlow.title: Open Operations Launchpad
demoFlow.expectedSignal: Launchpad shows entry cards, validation commands, delivery readiness, and disabled real actions.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Use Launchpad as the first screen for operators.

demoFlow.title: Open Operations Demo Map
demoFlow.expectedSignal: Demo Map shows role-based static page order and safe commands.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Explain the role paths before drilling into individual pages.

demoFlow.title: Open Operations Runbook
demoFlow.expectedSignal: Runbook references scripts/phase1-demo.runbook.json, scripts/manifest.json, and safety red lines.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Clarify that manual preview commands are not automated scripts.

demoFlow.title: Run Phase 1 self-check
demoFlow.expectedSignal: success=true, data.passed=true, and total checks remain 20.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Show that DSL validation, review gate, MockProvider, workflow log, and safety checks pass.

demoFlow.title: Export local delivery package
demoFlow.speakerCue: State that the package is local, reproducible, and not uploaded.

demoFlow.title: Render local acceptance report
demoFlow.speakerCue: Use the report as a readable summary, not as a source of new generated content.

demoFlow.title: Open Operations Acceptance
demoFlow.expectedSignal: Acceptance page shows required items, linked pages, safe commands, and disabled uploads.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Connect the CLI evidence to the static acceptance page.

demoFlow.title: Open Delivery Acceptance Preview
demoFlow.expectedSignal: Delivery page shows manifest ready count, acceptance checklist, Phase 1 check, and safety assertions.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Use this page to verify the delivery package contract in a human-readable way.

demoFlow.title: Open Audit Incident Review
demoFlow.expectedSignal: Incident page shows failed mock records, rules, and safe recovery steps.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Demonstrate how operators triage failures without retrying real calls.

demoFlow.title: Validate CLI review priority queue
demoFlow.expectedSignal: review batch-summary exposes reviewPriorityQueue with priority, reasonCode, recommendedAction, autoApproveAllowed=false, and batchStateChangeAllowed=false.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Show that operators can sort waiting review tasks without enabling batch approval or publish.

demoFlow.title: Validate Backend and MCP review priority queue
demoFlow.expectedSignal: GET /api/review-task-summary and MCP get_review_task_summary both expose data.reviewTaskSummary.reviewPriorityQueue for human triage only.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Explain that CLI, Backend, and MCP read the same priority queue contract.

demoFlow.title: Confirm human review gate
demoFlow.expectedSignal: Generated Lab, Exam, Grading, and PPT DSL remain WAITING_REVIEW before approval.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Say explicitly that generated content is never auto-published.

demoFlow.title: Confirm blocked actions
demoFlow.expectedSignal: Real LLM, real agent, real cloud, real sandbox, contestant execution, unknown Shell, remote upload, auto publish, and real publish stay disabled.
demoFlow.speakerCue: Close the demo with the Phase 1 safety boundary.

acceptanceSignals.expected: frontend/operations-launchpad.html is the first static page opened.
phase1 check returns success=true and data.passed=true.
phase1 report returns acceptancePassed=true and safetyAssertionsPassed=true.
WAITING_REVIEW is visible in the review and delivery narrative.
reviewPriorityQueue is visible through CLI, Backend, and MCP as human triage only.
All real execution, upload, provider, agent, and publish actions remain disabled.

blockedActions: Do not run unknown Shell scripts
Do not start a real agent
Do not call a real LLM provider
Do not create or delete real cloud resources
Do not auto-publish or real-publish generated content
Do not show secrets or candidate-hidden answers
